description: Archive a task on demand — move it to the vault's archive AS-IS, preserving its current status (an open task stays open in the archive). This is distinct from complete_task: it does NOT complete the task first. Destination follows the vault's archive config (a same-file section, a cross-file archive file, or a TaskNotes whole-file relocation); a space the task belongs to that keeps its own storage settings supplies its own archive file or folder. Pass space to name the space; warnings say when the task's spaces disagree and the vault-wide archive was used. Chain if_hash from get_task for optimistic concurrency.

space.description:
Archive with this saved space's (id or name, as `list_spaces`
reports it) archive folder or file rather than the one the task's
own spaces select. Without it, a space the task
belongs to that keeps its own storage settings decides. An unknown space is refused.

name: archive_task
